title: Transcutaneous Bilirubin Measurements in Neonates Post Phototherapy
brief_summary: Can transcutaneous bilirubin (TcB) measurements be utilised to assess rebound hyperbilirubinaemia following phototherapy in neonates?
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Well neonates
* 35+0 weeks gestation or greater, over 24 hours old
* Inpatients at Princess Royal Maternity (PRM), NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwell neonates
* Less than 35+0 weeks' gestation
* Less than 24 hours old
* Mother unable or too distressed to give informed consent
